caption: Acts explicitly places Psalm 2 in its resurrection argument. But the psalm itself describes a living king’s installation—not crucifixion, burial or resurrection.

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: Did Psalm 2 intimate crucifixion? Acts recounts Jesus’s death and resurrection, then quotes Psalm 2: “You are My Son.”
